svg.text: The whole pipeline — which module does what, where it runs, and what it hands over
Read top to bottom by lane (where the code runs) and left to right by stage (when). Files in the case folder are the hand-over between programs.
main() runs them one after another,
each into its own SIM_i/ case folder
